original_policy: Only confirmed original-context evidence changes trigger independent concern review; unaffected scores are carried with a reason. Unknown/contradictory meanings stay null or require clarification.
conditional_policy: Shared LLM scoring rubric in the modified context. Explicit equivalent unchanged applicability can reuse a facet decision under the same policy; mitigated objections must be reassessed. Unknown required facets remain unavailable. No bonus or automatic cap removal.

conditional_anchors.1: Explicit categorical refusal of this specified aspect despite any restriction, consent, mitigation, benefit or other modification. This takes precedence over score 2; removing the rejected aspect does not make that aspect acceptable. Do not infer from route rejection alone.
conditional_anchors.2: Strong personal intrusion/risk boundary requiring removal or avoidance of the effect; needs evidence beyond strong disruption to daily life. Conditional openness does not erase the boundary.
conditional_anchors.3: Strong concrete disruption to rest or daily life requiring substantial mitigation, removal or avoidance; strong acoustic disturbance alone fits here rather than automatically constituting a personal intrusion boundary.
conditional_anchors.4: Localized intrusion/reservation with conditional openness requiring a meaningful change.
conditional_anchors.5: Balanced concern-specific willingness and reservations; uncertainty without a position stays null.
conditional_anchors.6: Accepts this specified aspect with explicitly expressed caution or limited reservations. Plain acceptance without a stated reservation is 8; other-aspect objections do not supply caution. Already stipulated proposal conditions are not further requirements.
conditional_anchors.7: Accepts this specified aspect with manageable remaining requirements or reservations; preserve those requirements.
conditional_anchors.8: Clear acceptance or support of this specified aspect without an expressed reservation, including a brief statement that it is acceptable. Lack of enthusiasm is not caution; other concern opposition is separate. Unqualified endorsement uses 9.
conditional_anchors.9: Explicit citizen-authored unqualified endorsement, no remaining requirements; independently checked. Bare Yes/choices/confirmation do not suffice.

aggregation: Each profile independently uses scoring.json: assessed-only mean, at least one assessed concern, minimum assessed concern plus 2 cap across all phases without a severity threshold, and half-down rounding. Coverage differences are not personal improvement or decline.

combined_changes.q1: Navigation cameras use the hypothetical Lens-Shielding Hardware Shroud: only direct forward viewing, with no downward viewing into private yards/windows. Telemetry and cybersecurity arrangements remain unspecified.
combined_changes.q2: The residential route operates at120 meters instead of60 meters, with no flights between19:00 and07:00. Assume the sound profile is below ambient city street noise. Frequency remains up to15 flights/day. Altitude, sound and curfew are a bundle, not independently tested changes.

evidence_projection: Original assessment preserves distinct aspect meanings: uncertainty stays recorded separately from clear established aspects. Conditional assessment requires every genuinely evidenced current aspect; superseded testimony and question-only nominations cannot create requirements. Joint acceptance links declared tested aspects; explicit applicability confirmation links an unchanged established meaning, with documented equivalent-meaning reuse under the shared policy or independent descriptive re-review.
